positive_results: An integral unimodular auxiliary-axis coframe supports the original block permutations, positive energy and signed pair hypercharges (-1,+1); the full 10D C/J lifts explicitly change and still do not preserve fixed hypercharge.

The existing weak-occupation mark S obeys {S,d_H}=0 on actual up/down Higgs coefficients, making (S d_H) tensor epsilon(h) symmetric on complete indices. Rank remains deficient and physical current-to-fermion descent is open.
V preserves the native joint event kernel; L has an exact nonzero escape witness of squared branch norm 1/7200. The full two-source event gap is 2-sqrt(3).
For d=J(2-sqrt(3))-4kappa-2mu>2kappa there is a canonical common spectral isometry W=Pi P(P Pi P)^(-1/2), transporting H, V and observables together on the two-source system.
The explicitly added relative-phase diagnostic has first nonconstant COMPLETE LABEL TRACE moment at degree 8; directed observables need not wait to degree 8.
